name: io.github.ProspectAPIs/prospectapis-mcp
title: ProspectAPIs
description: MCP server for prospectapis.com: funding rounds and cited prospect research briefs.

environmentVariables.name: PROSPECTAPIS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your prospectapis.com API key (pa_live_...). Get one at https://prospectapis.com. Needed for every tool except pricing_get and api_version.

environmentVariables.name: PROSPECTAPIS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.prospectapis.com; only set it if you were given a different endpoint.
